title: Automated Materials Data and Knowledge Extraction using Machine Learning and Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.29895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Over the past decade, substantial efforts have been devoted to developing machine learning (ML) methods for extracting materials data and, where possible, materials knowledge directly from the scientific literature. This review traces the evolution of these methods from heuristic, rule-based pipelines through natural language processing (NLP) models and transformer-based encoders to, lastly, large language models (LLMs) and agentic systems capable of extracting materials information across multiple modalities, including text, tables, and figures. Beside construction of large, queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs that support downstream materials discovery, we discuss how these advances have enabled new capabilities, such as, generic question answering across materials science, AI co-scientists and chatbots for research assistance, and closed-loop optimization and discovery when integrated with autonomous laboratories. translated_title: 基于机器学习与大型语言模型的材料数据与知识自动化提取
translated_abstract: 在过去十年中，研究者们投入了大量精力来开发机器学习方法，用于直接从科学文献中提取材料数据，并在可能的情况下提取材料知识。本综述追溯了这些方法的演进历程：从启发式的、基于规则的流水线，到自然语言处理（NLP）模型和基于Transformer的编码器，再到大型语言模型（LLMs）以及能够从文本、表格和图像等多种模态中提取材料信息的智能体系统。除了构建支持下游材料发现的大型可查询材料数据库和知识图谱之外，我们还讨论了这些进展如何催生了新的能力，例如面向材料科学的通用问答、用于科研辅助的AI科学家助手和聊天机器人，以及与自主实验室集成后实现的闭环优化与材料发现。
tldr: 本综述系统回顾了材料数据与知识自动提取方法从规则流水线、NLP模型到大型语言模型与智能体系统的演进，并阐述了其在构建材料数据库与知识图谱、通用问答、AI科研助手以及结合自主实验室的闭环材料发现中的新能力。
en_tdlr: This review traces the evolution of automated materials data and knowledge extraction from rule-based pipelines through NLP and transformer models to LLMs and agentic systems, highlighting new capabilities such as queryable materials databases and knowledge graphs, generic question answering, AI co-scientists, and closed-loop discovery integrated with autonomous laboratories.
